# The compact list and generated projection apply their documented top-ten limits.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe add 'Doing item' --state doing

# More than ten Todo items: the compact board shows ten, while state listing shows all.
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 01' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 02' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 03' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 04' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 05' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 06' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 07' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 08' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 09' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 10' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Todo 11' --state todo

exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 01'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 02'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 03'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 04'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 05'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 06'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 07'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 08'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 09'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 10'
exec tuck$exe add 'Backlog 11'

exec tuck$exe add 'Done 01' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 02' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 03' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 04' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 05' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 06' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 07' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 08' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 09' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 10' --state done
exec tuck$exe add 'Done 11' --state done

exec tuck$exe list --json
json
stdout -count=10 '"state": "todo"'
stdout -count=10 '"state": "backlog"'
stdout -count=10 '"state": "done"'
stdout '"title": "Doing item"'
! stdout '"title": "Todo 11"'
! stdout '"title": "Backlog 11"'
! stdout '"title": "Done 01"'

exec tuck$exe list todo --json
json
stdout -count=11 '"state": "todo"'
stdout '"title": "Todo 11"'
exec tuck$exe list --limit 2
stdout 'Doing item'
stdout 'Todo 01'
! stdout 'Backlog'

exec tuck$exe sync
stdout 'Synchronized board.md'
grep -count=10 '^- [0-9][0-9][0-9] Todo ' board.md
grep -count=10 '^- [0-9][0-9][0-9] Backlog ' board.md
grep -count=10 '^- [0-9][0-9][0-9] Done ' board.md
grep 'Doing item' board.md
